lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a regular grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits, with clusters appearing approximately equidistant within horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots at near-perpendicular angles, forming a lattice of high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient where high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side of the ridge transition to a dark shadow region on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Several small, dark-toned elongated objects (remoras) are visible near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin and along the ventral surface.
